final: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), u AS (SELECT zoneref, articount, CASE WHEN articount IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(articount AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM t) END AS share FROM scanfeatures), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM u) SELECT u.zoneref AS site_code, u.articount AS artifact_count, u.share AS share, u.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM u, a WHERE (SELECT total FROM t) IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
